sources.title: AMD-PAVS-AI/easyocr · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: EasyOCR is a ready-to-use optical character recognition (OCR) pipeline combining a CRAFT text-detection model with a CRNN text-recognition model, supporting 80+ languages. This repository packages inference for OCR (text detection + recognition) using ONNX Runtime, exported and validated for AMD ROCm so it runs efficiently on AMD GPUs, CPUs, and NPUs.

sources.title: Custom Models | JaidedAI/EasyOCR | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This document describes how to create and use custom text recognition models with EasyOCR. While EasyOCR provides pre-trained models for many languages, custom models allow you to optimize recognition
